tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gsung ngag rin po che brgyud pa gsum 'dus kyi bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa lam rim smon lam dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥ kun bzang dbang bzhi'i char rgyun 'khor lo'i mgon// gsang chen lam bzhi ston mdzad chos kyi rje// sku bzhi mngon gyur bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'og min chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing khams su// kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan rdzogs sangs rgyas// sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba rje// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// zag med bde chen sgyu ma'i pho brang du// ma lus rgyal ba skyed dang rol pa'i yum// grangs med mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo rje btsun ma// rdo rje bdag med ma la gsol ba 'debs// lho phyogs sau wa nā tha'i gnas mchog tu// gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen chos skyong zhabs// mkha' 'gros rjes bzung 'phags yul grub pa'i gtso// rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// ri bo u tsā ya na'i gnas mchog tu// mu stegs rigs la rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// rjes su bzung nas mkha' 'gro'i zhal gdams thob// shar phyogs nag po pa la gsol ba 'debs// rgya gar kā ma rū pa'i gnas mchog tu// rgyal rigs mchog la grub dbang gdams pas grol// gsang chen zab mo cang te'u'i sgra sgrogs pa// ḍā ma ru pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// shar phyogs mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i ljongs lung du// dam pa'i drin las 'phags pa'i go 'phang thob// gnyis spangs spyod pas byis pa'i tshogs dbus rol// a wa dhū tī pa la gsol ba 'debs// ru mtshams kha reg thod bu'i gnas mchog tu// 'phags yul paṇa grub gangs can skyong ba'i dpal// 'pho ba'i lam gyis mkha' spyod gnas su byon// ga ya dha ra'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mang mkhar mu gu lung gi gnas mchog tu// 'phags yul grub dbang gdams pa'i bcud bsdus nas// bod yul rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan mchog

/bla chen 'brog mi'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mkhar chung chu kha'i gnas mchog dam pa ru// dul ba'i spyod pas dam pa'i thugs zin nas// yongs rdzogs gsung ngag ḍā ki'i zhal 'ong thob// se ston kun rig zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// sag thang ding gi grub pa'i gnas mchog tu// birwa'i thugs bcud gsung ngag rab tu thob// rdzu 'phrul mngon shes thogs med sbas pa'i rje// zhang ston chos 'bar zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// byang phyogs skya bo kha gdang sgrub gnas su// 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul gsang chen rgyud sde'i bdag /gsung ngag zab mo'i shing rta'i srol 'byed mchog /rje btsun sa skya pa la gsol ba 'debs// grom stod chu mig rdzing kha'i gnas mchog tu// mi thub zla ba'i rnam 'phrul gsang chen la// mkhas shing grub par mkha' 'gros rab bsgrags pa'i// slob dpon rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// sgo rum gzim spyil dkar po'i gnas mchog tu// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rje bo grags pa'i zhabs// mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang phyug bla ma rje// rje btsun rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// byang ngos sprul pa sde yi lha khang du// gnas lnga rig pa'i mthar son 'jam dpal dbyangs// dregs ldan rgol ba 'joms pa'i dpa' bo che// sa skya paṇa chen zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// lha khang bla brang dam pa'i gzim khang du// stobs ldan gtsug gi nor bu'i khrir bzhugs nas// lugs gnyis dpal gyis gangs can skyong ba'i rje// chos rgyal 'phags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan sa skya'i skye 'phrang bla brang du// dka' ba khyad bsad yongs rdzogs gsung ngag thob// smin grol gdams pas skal ldan skyong ba'i dpal// zhang ston dkon mchog dpal la gsol ba 'debs// dger phu rdzi lung dben pa'i gnas mchog tu// sa skya paṇa chen thugs sras mchog gyur pa// rtogs pa'i brgyud 'dzin tshogs sgom rin po che// kun dga' dpal gyi zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// byang phyogs nyan po dgon pa'i gnas mchog tu// mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin// snyan brgyud zab mo'i gter mdzod nyan chen pa// bsod nams brtan pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dben pa'i sgrub gnas na bza' brag phug tu// rtse gcig bsgrubs pas nyams rtogs mthar phyin nas// zab mo'i lam gyi gter mdzod gcig gyur pa// grub chen brag phug pa la gsol ba 'debs// bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i bla brang du// mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje// byang phyogs 'di na thams cad mkhyen par grags// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// tsha rong byang chub rdzong gi dben gnas su// chos rje bla ma'i thugs sras mchog gyur pa// gsung ngag bstan pa 'dzin pa'i chos kyi rje// dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// grub pa'i gnas mchog zhe dgon dben pa ru// 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i rol rtsed las// sbyor lam rtse mo'i ting 'dzin dpal thob pa// grub chen buddha shrī la gsol ba 'debs// e waṃ chos ldan rdo rje'i pho brang du// rgyal bas lung bstan gsang chen bstan pa'i dpal// gangs can mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan mchog

/ngor chen rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// stag mo gling khar dben pa'i ri khrod du// rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs kyi mdzod bzung nas// gsang chen gdams pas skal ldan skyong ba'i dpal// sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// shab smad dge sdings rdo rje'i pho brang du// thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi// rigs kyi dbon po thugs sras mchog gyur pa// bla chen kun rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// grom stod dbu rtse rnying ma'i gzim khang du// theg chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang*// chos kyi rgyal po byang phyogs skye rgu'i mgon// theg chen chos rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du// padma'i rnam 'phrul mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag /chig brgyud gdams pa'i bka' babs rje btsun yab// nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// phyogs med mkhas pa 'du ba'i gnas mchog tu// mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan nges don zab mo'i gter// byang phyogs 'di na nya dbon chen por grags// kun dga' dpal gyi zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// nyang stod brtse chen chos sde'i gzim khang du// gsang chen zab mo'i gdams pa'i mdzod bzung nas// nyams dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid chos kyi rje// grub chen kun blo'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dpal 'khor bde chen mkhas pa'i chos grwa ru// phyi nang gzhan gsum rtogs pa'i grub dbang rje// lung rigs smra ba'i gtsug rgyan 'jam pa'i dbyangs// dkon mchog bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen du// sa chen rnam 'phrul snyan brgyud gdams pa'i gter// nyams rtogs mthar son mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag /bdag chen rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// kha'u brang rdzong nag po'i ri khrod du// rdor 'dzin bye ba'i gtsug rgyan rdo rje 'chang*// gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag drin chen rje// kun spangs chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// phun tshogs rab brtan rgyal po'i pho brang du// rgyal ba kun dngos nges don bstan pa'i bdag
/zab mo'i lam gyis skal ldan rjes 'dzin pa'i// rje btsun rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// ༈

//kha skong ni/ /rgyal khams phyogs med yangs pa'i sman ljongs su// shes ldan gzur gnas nam mkha'i mtha' klas par// kun spangs chos rje'i phrin las skyong ba'i dpal// blo gsal rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// zhwa lu gser khang mkhas pa'i chos grwa ru// tshar pa chos rje'i snyan brgyud mdzod bzung nas// rang don zhen med skal ldan skyong ba'i dpal// skal bzang mkhyen brtse'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs// bkra shis dge mtshan dpal gyi chos grwa ru// 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos blo gsal rgya mtsho yi// thugs sras snyan brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal tshab mchog /gzhon nu blo gros zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dam pas byin brlabs sgrub sde'i gnas mchog tu// 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i thugs sras rgyal tshab mchog /rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun sding ma ba// bslab gsum rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// snyan brgyud chos 'khor bskor ba'i sman ljongs su// 'khrul med slob bshad gdams pa'i dga' ston gyis// skal ldan gdul bya'i re ba skong mdzad pa// dbang phyug rab brtan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa ru// mtha' yas dam chos nor bu'i mdzod bzung nas// thub bstan nyin mor byed pa'i drin can rje// bsod nams mchog ldan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gsang chen 'brug sgra sgrogs pa'i lho mos su// snyan brgyud slob bshad kun gyi mdzod bzung nas// snod ldan smin grol lam la 'god mdzad pa'i// bsod nams mchog grub zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan gnas kyi dbang po'i chos grwa ru// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla mas rjes bzung nas// 'gro la dam chos bdud rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed// mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal la gsol ba 'debs// snyan brgyud chos kyi 'byung gnas 'dus pa'i sder// rgyal ba kun dngos tshar chen bla ma yi// zab lam spel mkhas drin can rdo rje 'chang*// blo gsal mchog ldan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dam pas byin brlabs dben pa'i bzhugs gnas su// mkhyen rab bla ma'i thugs sras gdams pa'i gter// tshar pa chos rje'i phrin las skyong ba'i dpal// rmor chen rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs//

tshar chen nas 'di yan bla ma snga ma'i bstod pa phyi mas zhal skong dang*/ rjes ma gnyis zhal gsungs ma'o// 7gsung ngag rin po che brgyud pa gsum 'dus kyi gsol 'debs tshar pa rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i kha skong ni/ ( ngor brgyud pa ltar na/ theg mchog 'byung gnas bkra shis chos sde ru// rgyal ba kun dngos tshar chen he ru ka'i// rnam rol 'brel tshad don ldan sprul pa'i sku// kun dga' legs 'byung zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bzhi thog 'chi med rdo rje'i gur khang du// snyigs dus dmu rgod 'gro 'dul sems dpa' che// khyad par gsum ldan gdung 'dzin sa skya pa// kun dga' blo gros zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan lhun grub steng gi chos grwa ru// 'phags nor rin chen bdun la dbang 'byor zhing*// mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan 'gran zla bral// nam mkha' 'chi med zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// e wam̐ thar pa rtse yi gzim khang du// kun bzang chos kyi srid la dbang bsgyur zhing*// gsung ngag gdams pa'i gter mdzod bka' drin can// mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// nges pa lnga ldan e wam̐ chos ldan du// rgyal kun 'dus zhal mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang*// byams pa kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs// mnyam med bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs/ 'di mkhan chen ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'o/ /lugs brgya'i 'dun sa nyin dgon pho brang du// mdo rgyud man ngag kun la dbang 'byor zhing*// snyigs dus bstan pa'i sgron me khang gsar ba// bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// e wam̐ khang gsar rnam rgyal pho brang du// 'jigs bral rnal 'byor dbang phyug dgongs pa'i bcud// gsung ngag dbang bzhis 'gro kun smin mdzad pa// blo gros snying po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// lung rtogs 'byung gnas rdzong gsar chos grwa ru// dam pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs mkhas shing*// skal ldan 'gro rnams smin cing grol mdzad pa'i// kun dga' 'jam dpal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mdo smad lhun grub yang rtse'i dben gnas su// zab gsang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i shing rta che// mkhas shing grub pa'i mthar son 'jam pa'i dbyangs// blo gter dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// brag ra bde gshegs gling gi dben gnas su// theg gsum chos kyi sgra dbyangs rtag sgrogs shing*// rigs gsum gdul bya smin mdzad 'jam pa'i dbyangs// chos kyi nyi ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mkhas grub gong ma'i gdan sa nges med du// mdo rgyud man ngag du ma'i mdzod bzung nas// ris med 'gro la gsang chen lam ston pa// gzhan phan snying po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma

sogs dang sbrel lo// zhes pa 'di'ang bya bral ba ngag dbang legs grub kyis 'bras yul skyed mos tshal du gsung ngag rin po che skal ldan gyi slob bu nyung shas la bshad pa dang*/ 'dus tshogs yongs la dbang gi mngon par rtog pa brgyad ldan gyis smin par byas pa'i tshe bris pa'o//) ༈ /yang nā lend+ra'i brgyud pa ltar na/ rmor chen yan spar ma bzhin la/ de nas/ rgyal khams ris med skal ldan gdul bya la// gsung ngag dbang bzhi'i smin grol legs bstan nas// gsang chen bstan pa spel ba'i rdo rje 'chang*// gnas gsar chos rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bod yul rdo rje gdan gyi bzhi thog tu// dpal ldan chos skyong ring lugs spel ba'i slad// bsam bzhin rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs pa// kun dga' blo gros zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan rtse gdong dge ba'i chos grwa ru// legs gdams lha yi rnga sgras skal bzang rnams// gsang chen zab mo'i lam la 'god mdzad pa// bstan 'dzin lhun grub zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// chos rdzong shar gyi dben gnas nyams dga' ru// sbas pa'i brtul zhugs zhi dul bag yod kyis// thub bstan nyi mor mdzad pa'i bshes gnyen che// blo gsal phun tshogs zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bco brgyad rdo rje pho brang dam pa ru/ nges gsang snying po'i nyams len mthar son nas// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa ngag gi dbang*// kun dga' mkhyen rab zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'brug gur dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bro ra nas// 'khor 'das mnyam par gzigs pa'i bdag nyid che// dran pa'i gdung sel skyabs mchog 'khor lo'i mgon// phyogs las rnam rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gzim 'og mdo sngags chos kyi pho brang du// rnam 'dren zung gi phrin las thur brgya pa// dad brtson dpung pas 'degs la mi ngal ba'i// snyan grags mtshan can zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'dam bu'i 'byin gyi pho brang dam pa ru// rdo rje 'chang dbang ya sha'i mtshan can gyi// rigs dbon thugs kyi sras mchog chos kyi rje// lha btsun mkhyen brtse dbang por gsol ba 'debs// dam pa'i gzim khang 'og ma'i gnas mchog tu// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rje btsun bla ma yi// sprul pa'i sku mchog ngur smrig gar rol ba// kun dga' bstan 'dzin zhabs la gsol 'debs// ngag gi dbang po'i byin rlabs thugs la shar// blo gros chen pos rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rtogs// gzhan phan phrin las phyogs bcu kun tu rgyas// snying po'i bstan 'dzin mchog la gsol ba 'debs// snying dbus padmo 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i dbus// tshul min yid byed mun pa drung phyung nas// rang bzhin 'od gsal don gyi gnas lugs mchog

/snang mdzad rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /ces pa 'di gzim 'og sprul ming gis sbyar ba'o// /de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma kun gyi dngos// skyabs gsum gcig bsdus rigs brgya'i khyab bdag che// dkyil 'khor gtso bo drin can chos kyi rjer// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// nyin mo spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng dang*// mtshan mo snying dbus 'od lnga'i gur khang du// 'bral med bzhugs nas brtse chen thugs rje yis// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i rnam thar thos pa'i mod// sprin gyi rnga gsang thos pa'i rma bya ltar// dad dang spro ba'i spu long cher g.yos te// byin rlabs snying la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// bslu med skyabs mgon bla ma dkon mchog la// bdag dang mar gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa// byang chub bar du re ltos rtse gcig pas// thugs rje'i skyabs 'og chud par byin gyis rlobs// thog med dus nas bdag gzhan 'gro ba rnams// mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho cher 'khyams te// bzod med sdug bsngal gsum gyis gdungs pa las// nges 'byung drag po skye bar byin gyis rlobs// rnyed dka' don dang ldan pa'i dal 'byor lus// yun ring mi sdod 'chi ba'i tshul nges te// dgos med tshe 'di'i bya ba kun dor nas// rtse gcig snying po lon par byin gyis rlobs// bde sdug las kyi 'bras bu shes gyur nas// mi dge kun spangs btang snyoms ma lus par// rtag tu dge ba bsgrub la mi g.yel ba'i// blang dor tshul bzhin byed par byin gyis rlobs// ma gyur 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma bzod nas// byams dang snying rje'i shugs kyis drangs pa yis// de dag don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog /thob 'dod smon sems bskyed par byin gyis rlobs// theg chen lam gyi gzhung shing tshul khrims gsum// bdag gzhan mnyam brje phyin drug bsdu dngos bzhi// rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa mtha' dag la// snying stobs chen pos slob par byin gyis rlobs// gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa'i lhag mthong dang*// g.yo med ting 'dzin brtan pa'i zhi gnas mchog

/zung 'jug brjod med ngang du bsgoms pa yis/ gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// thun mong lam gyis rang rgyud legs sbyangs shing*// thun mong min pa'i lam la nges shes rnyed// rgyal ba'i yon tan kun gyis yid 'phrog ste// myur du thob 'dod skye bar byin gyis rlobs// mtshan nyid kun ldan rdo rje slob dpon las// gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru// rnam dag dbang bzhi'i chu bo legs thob nas// sku bzhi'i rten 'brel 'grig par byin gyis rlobs// dkyil 'khor gtso bo rje btsun he ru ka /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dpang btsugs te// dam tshig nyi shu bsrung tshul rnam pa bzhi// srog dang bsdos te bsrung bar byin gyis rlobs// rang sems lhan skyes spros bral rgyu yi rgyud// gsal stong zung du 'jug pa gdod ma'i gshis// 'khor 'das dbyer med brjod bral bde chen dbyings// gnas lugs rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs// 'khor 'das chos kun rang sems snang ba'i mdangs// snang yang rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma'i gar// med bzhin ci yang 'char ba rten 'brel gshis// brjod bral lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs// tha mal snod bcud snang ba ji snyed pa// lam byed rnam bzhis rten dang brten pa yi// dkyil 'khor chen por bsgom pas cir snang kun// lhag pa'i lha ru 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor rnam pa bzhi// gdan gsum tshang ba'i rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du// shes nas bsgoms pas snang stong zung 'jug gis// ye shes rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// las rlung sbyor ba bdun gyis rab bcings shing*// phyogs dang gdengs can 'bar ba'i tsaṇḍa lis// ham̐ yig bdud rtsir zhu ba'i rnal 'byor gyis// gsal stong ye shes skye bar byin gyis rlobs// dngos dang ye shes mtshan ldan phyag rgya mar// sku gsum lam byed sbyor bas snyoms zhugs pas// zhu ba'i yas babs dga' ba'i ros tshims nas// bde stong ye shes skye bar byin gyis rlobs// lus ngag rba rlabs sbyor bas legs sbyangs nas// padma can dang lhan cig ting 'dzin gyis// rba rlabs mchog gis gzung 'dzin rtog pa bcom// bde stong mchog la rol bar byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba'i bka' dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gzhung*// mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung gi gdams pa'i bcud// rtse gcig bsgoms pas nyams rtogs nang nas shar// tshad ma bzhi ldan 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// dbang dang byin rlabs brgyud pa ma nyams shing*// 'khrul med gdams pa go rim ji bzhin du// nyams su blangs nas drod rtags mngon du gyur// mos gus bsam pa tshims par byin gyis rlobs// bogs 'byin brgyad kyis ting 'dzin bogs dbyung zhing*// gdams ngag drug dang srung ba sum cu yis// bar chad kun sel rten 'brel rnam pa lngas// lam gyi sa mtshams shes par byin gyis rlobs// 'dus pa gsum la snang ba dgrar langs dang*// stong pa dgrar langs bying ba chen po yi// 'phrang gsum sgrol ba'i spyod pa rnam gsum gyis// ting 'dzin lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs// zab mo dbang bzhi'i lam la goms pa'i mthus// chung 'bring chen po'i drod kyi rim pa ltar// gsang ba kun 'dar kun tu bzang po yi// brtul zhugs spyod pa skyong bar byin gyis rlobs// mi lpags gos gyon stag sham rus rgyan spras// cang te'u'i sgra sgrogs mi rkang gling bu 'bud// kha ṭwāṃ thogs nas dung chen pad phor du// bdud rtsi lnga la rol bar byin gyis rlobs// sku bzhi mnga' ba'i dpal ldan bla ma las// dbang bzhi blangs pas dkyil 'khor rnam pa bzhi// mngon gyur bcu gnyis sa yi yon tan thob// grub mtha' rnam bzhi snyogs par byin gyis rlobs// bha ga mchog gi dkyil 'khor nyams dga' na// bzhugs pa'i bde gshegs bcud bsdus slob dpon las// 'bras dus dbang gi chu bo
